newsitem.title: SPAIN: GOLF-TORRANCE DISQUALIFIED AFTER SLEEPING IN.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-TORRANCE DISQUALIFIED AFTER SLEEPING IN.

text.p: Ryder Cup player Sam Torrance was disqualified from the Oki Pro-Am when he overslept and failed to meet his tee time for the opening round of the European Tour event on Thursday.
The 43-year-old Scot was due to be second off on the La Moraleja One course with Manuel Ballesteros but slept in at his Madrid hotel.
Fellow Briton Andrew Barnett, called in at short notice to fill Torrance's shoes, shot ad two-over-par 74, nine shots adrift of the leader, Spain's Pedro Linhart.
Linhart's 65 on the shorter of the two courses being used for the event, included an eagle two at the 374-yard fifth where he holed his second shot with a nine iron.
Tom Kite, captain of next year's U.S. Ryder Cup team, shot a 71, a round spoiled by bogeys at the last two holes. His European counterpart Seve Ballesteros had a 72.
